clone-api-limitation.claim: GitHub clone traffic is dominated by CI and is not an adoption metric
clone-api-limitation.evidence: 2026-09-27, 14-day window: pycubrid 700 workflow runs vs 4,969 clones (495 unique); sqlalchemy-cubrid 1,103 runs vs 5,742 clones (547 unique)
clone-api-limitation.note: actions/checkout performs a real git fetch; each hosted runner counts as a unique cloner
